adjudications.sourceSentence: Local artists should not be pushed to the sidelines.
adjudications.meaningEvidence: The guide says artists lose centrality or influence. Selected owner 4208 'watch from/stand on the sidelines' instead describes observing without joining and does not imply that someone else marginalized the observer.
adjudications.requiredGuard: Add the passive/active destination variant 'to the sidelines' to owner 287, retain margins, and show reduced participation or influence without implying literal seats or complete exclusion. A bounded lexical pattern could end 'to the (?:margins|sidelines)'. Do not route this passive marginalization example to owner 4208.
